question: Which interface term should represent a login-gated, browser-only DNS delegation panel when programme access is unavailable, given that the interface vocabulary has browser and unknown but no term for a human-reviewed web form?
why: EU.org changes to the records it holds (NS, glue and DS) only through the web panel at https://nic.eu.org/arf/; browser is the nearest term but it does not convey that the panel is human-reviewed and has no programme access, and the actual subdomain records are managed at whichever external DNS host the delegation names
